node: Public power, grid hardening, and regulated infrastructure equipment
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the public-power/grid-hardening node with one obvious reference leader and three underfollowed direct-exposure names. The strongest mapped exposures are electrical infrastructure contractors, engineered switchgear/power-control equipment, and transmission/distribution line hardware. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation. Expanded the public-power/grid-hardening node with a deliberately underfollowed lens. Reference anchors such as GE Vernova and Quanta Services remain useful cycle indicators, but this pass prioritizes narrower equipment, components, coatings, and contractor names tied to utility capex, transmission/distribution buildout, storm hardening, wildfire mitigation, and electrical infrastructure lead-time pressure. The strongest underfollowed candidates found in this pass are Powell Industries for switchgear/electrical distribution systems, Preformed Line Products for line hardware and utility inspection services, MYR Group for transmission/distribution contracting capacity, and AZZ for galvanizing/coatings used in transmission, distribution, and infrastructure steel. Layer 1B expands the public-market universe around public-power capex, grid hardening, utility transmission/distribution work, grid-edge intelligence, and regulated infrastructure equipment. The search pass keeps one larger reference name for cycle context while prioritizing less-obvious small/mid-cap contractors and utility technology vendors that may be one step removed from the political-policy headline. No trading recommendatio
